definitions.explanation: The practice of waking up early to engage in productive activities before work or school, such as exercise, study, or hobbies.

examples.japanese: {朝活|あさかつ}で{英語|えいご}の{勉強|べんきょう}をしている。
examples.english: I study English as part of my morning activity.

examples.japanese: {朝活|あさかつ}を{始|はじ}めてから{生活|せいかつ}リズムが{整|ととの}った。
examples.english: Since starting morning activities, my daily rhythm has improved.

examples.japanese: カフェで{朝活|あさかつ}をする{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: More people are doing morning activities at cafes.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: Abbreviation of {朝|あさ}の{活動|かつどう} (morning activity). Part of the ～{活|かつ} word pattern.

RELATED ～{活|かつ} WORDS:
・{就活|しゅうかつ} ({就職|しゅうしょく}{活動|かつどう}) - job hunting
・{婚活|こんかつ} ({結婚|けっこん}{活動|かつどう}) - spouse hunting
・{保活|ほかつ} ({保育園|ほいくえん}{活動|かつどう}) - daycare hunting
・{終活|しゅうかつ} ({終末|しゅうまつ}{活動|かつどう}) - end-of-life planning
・{妊活|にんかつ} ({妊娠|にんしん}{活動|かつどう}) - trying to conceive

POPULAR {朝活|あさかつ} ACTIVITIES:
・ジョギング/ランニング (jogging/running)
・ヨガ (yoga)
・{読書|どくしょ} (reading)
・{語学|ごがく}{学習|がくしゅう} (language study)
・{資格|しかく}{勉強|べんきょう} (studying for certifications)
・{朝食|ちょうしょく}ミーティング (breakfast meetings)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{朝活|あさかつ} became a trend in Japan in the 2010s as a way for busy professionals to make time for personal development. Cafes and coworking spaces began offering early morning hours to accommodate this trend. The concept emphasizes using the quiet early morning hours for focused, productive activities.
